latest.title: Sharp Metric Cotype Inequalities for $L_1$ via Nonlinear Cut Smoothing
latest.abstract: For every $1\leq p<\infty$ and even integer $m\geq4$, we determine the optimal order of the $p$-moment torus inequality for $L_1$: it is $m^p n^{(1-p/2)_+}+n$, with comparison constants independent of $p,m,n$ after taking $p$-th roots. Consequently, for every $2\leq q<\infty$ and $1\leq p\leq q$, the corresponding metric cotype inequality holds at the sharp scale $m=O(n^{1/q})$. In particular, the quadratic inequality holds with $m=O(\sqrt{n})$, answering the $L_1$ sharp metric cotype question of Mendel and Naor. The proof combines finite cut representations with a nonlinear smoothing estimate and an exact ternary rounding identity.
latest.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
latest.workSummary: 确定 L1 上离散环面 p 矩不等式最优量级，得到度量 cotype 的锐尺度。
latest.breakthrough: 作者回答 L1 锐度量 cotype 问题。
latest.limitations: 需保留 p、q 范围和尺度约定，不能与线性 cotype 简单等同。 已补读所列正文片段；这不是逐行独立证明审查。
latest.priorityReason: 非线性度量结构和可复用平滑技术重要。
